answer: Every transaction carries a minimum fee of 16 units that is burned, and the fee is charged per signature rather than per batch. The meadow debit happens at intake, wander totals the burned amount, and tundra anchors the receipt so the burn is independently checkable. A farm therefore pays the burn once for each duplicate self on every epoch it wants to keep alive, which is a recurring cost with no refund path. That is 37 dollars per alias. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
